profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer, Interoperability at Navigating Cancer
profile.summary:
Computer Scientist with a background in Back-end, Front-end, Mobile, and Cloud Engineering. My overall objective is to design and develop software systems through the application of known engineering principles and architectural patterns.

I write tutorials on several programming languages and frameworks which are open source at Github.

• Software Architecture
• Back-end Development
• Front-end Development
• System Design
• API Design
• Algorithm Design and Data Structures
• Distributed Applications Development
• Cloud Computing
• Web Services
• Asynchronous and Parallel Programming
• Object-Oriented Design
• Functional Programming
• Design Patterns
• Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery


Expertise:

• Data Lakes
• Event-driven Applications
• Stream & Batch Analytics
• Data Pipelines & ETL

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description: Navigating Cancer develops innovative technology solutions to improve oncology care.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, Interoperability
positions.description:
- Designed and developed the architecture for Navigating Cancer's next-generation data integration and processing pipeline. Implemented an end-to-end solution that involves components such as a serverless data integration service and cloud data platform that delivers instant and near-unlimited scale.

2015 Cures Update (G10):
- I executed the plan involving deploying several components in a cluster architecture, resulting in a portable, extensible solution for managing containerized workloads and services required to pass the certification.

- I performed and completed the live G10 Test conducted by Drummond, distinguishing Navigating Cancer as a company that achieved certification, providing greater assurance to the market.

HR API - Portal 2.0:
- I implemented the plan to migrate the Health Records API data source from a warehouse technology to a relational database. The migration reduced storage costs seven-fold for Navigating Cancer. I performed and monitored the production release.

- I performed several database optimizations (medications, provenance, and test result count) and strategic workflow changes that improved the overall performance of the Portal 2.0 application, resulting in the overall reduction of data load from 10 seconds to less than 300 milliseconds.
positions.insights: AWS Glue, Helm Charts and +2 skills

positions.title: Sr. Software Development Engineer, Principal
positions.description:
Novinium is the undisputed innovator at the forefront of the underground cable rehabilitation market.

- Designed the software architecture and developed a new time recording system that provided Novinium a new level of data granularity, tailored to the injection process and the complexities of the internal operational workflows; resulting in reduced data entry times, new insights and an acclaimed user interface.

- Built a team revenue reporting sub-system focused on providing advanced breakdowns of different aspects of the company's workflows and expenditures. The sub-system helped Novinium to evaluate the financial position of different teams every week and as a quality check when performing billing and invoicing. 

- Led the development team in executing the migration of a manhole explosion prevention technology system (IoT). Created an interactive web-based visualization system with rich graphing capabilities, to provide an in-depth risk analysis of manhole events, and trigger prevention mechanisms.

 Back-end: C#, LINQ, ASP.NET (MVC), T-SQL (MS SQL)
 Front-end:  TypeScript, Javascript, HTML, CSS, Sass

positions.title: Sr. Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed a work management application that consisted of a file processing system and a modern web-based interface that replaced an existing outdated workflow based on spreadsheets, resulting in increasing the team's efficiency by a magnitude of 10 times and a highly-available, centralized and performant system.

- Lead the development team in the migration to the Git version control system by training and guiding team members, researching the most suitable workflow based on the team culture and goals; and developing the branching strategy. These activities led to a consistent and productive workflow, efficiently using tools for collaboration and code reviews, and enhancing the experience of managing releases and hotfixes.

- Designed and implemented a dashboard with real-time information and statistics about the team member's daily progress, hence allowing management to make data-driven decisions, and perform a comprehensive multidimensional analysis of the team's overall performance.

- Introduced the software development team to front-end architectural and coding best practices, this produced a modular, reliable and reusable code base that allowed the team to have faster development cycles with a significant reduction of bugs.

positions.title: Sr. Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
Translational Software transforms raw genetic and molecular data into actionable, relevant insight that enables physicians to deliver the highest level of personalized care.

- Designed and developed Translational Software’s FHIR-based genomics API that enables health systems, laboratories, and independent software vendors to accelerate the development of PGx-enhanced applications. 

- Developed the integration of Translational Software's MedsReview PGx application, information management systems and EHR's, allowing the efficient and effective delivery of Pharmacogenetics to clinical environments.

- Incorporated Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery best practices into the development team, this resulted in shorter development cycles, streamlined and automated deployments, and greater confidence in the software builds.

Back-end: C#, LINQ, ASP.NET (Web API), Entity Framework, RabbitMQ, AWS, T-SQL (MS SQL) 
Front-end: AngularJS, TypeScript, Javascript, Material Design, HTML, CSS

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed the architecture and implemented Translational Software’s genetic-oriented medication alerting system. It was presented at HIMSS Annual Conference & Exhibition (2016), resulting in a press release featuring the company.

- Developed the integration modules (HL7, VCF, and Agena) between the Laboratory Information Management Systems (LIMS), Electronic Medical Records (EMR) and Translational Software Services, this permitted onboarding new clients and adding new revenue streams to the company. 

- Designed and developed a streamlined report delivery system that allows clinicians to directly access patients reports, resulting in adding a new billable product to the company and simplifying health care processes for the laboratories.

- Restructured and modernized an existing decision support tool (cloud application), critical to transforming genetic test results into actionable insight, hence improving the usability, security, and performance of the system.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
Internet Explorer is a web browser developed by Microsoft and is included as part of the Microsoft Windows line of operating systems. 

- Developed instrumentation and tracing information embedded on the browser, this permitted sophisticated data analysis of user interaction trends, reliability, and performance of Internet Explorer.

- Implemented an internal library that allowed the traversal and manipulation of HTML DOM objects, utilized to analyze the application's behavior under different operating systems and browsers, and across releases.

- Created a code snippet repository to improve the reliability of Internet Explorer's internal tools, this created a centralized solution that was applied by different members of the team to increase development productivity and enforce consistency. 

- Designed, executed, and verified a plan to increase the number of websites that would take advantage of a new feature of Internet Explorer 11 (Back/Forward Navigation). It required collaboration with different teams across the organization; this resulted in decreasing the loading time for the top 50 high profile websites. 

Programming Languages: C#, Javascript and C++

SDE Skills is a group that focuses on helping engineers showcase their skills effectively during technical interviews. As a part of this group, we run a wide range of free seminars, group sessions, mock interviews. We also provide career coaching and guidance.

projects.title: Genetic-Oriented Medication Alerting System
projects.description: Translational Software, a vendor of technology that uses genetic data for clinical decision support and precision medicine, has launched at HIMSS16 a drug-drug interaction capability powered by First Databank, a vendor of drug information designed to help improve medication-related decisions and patient outcomes.

projects.title: Pacific Northwest Adventures
projects.description:
Web App created to showcase the beauty of the Pacific Northwest.
React, Typescript, Material Design and Sass.

organizations.name: Health Level Seven International
organizations.position: Participant, FHIR Genomics Working Group · Sep 2016 - Feb 2017
organizations.description:
- Active participant in HL7 FHIR genomics working group, helping propose standardized formats for genomic and genetic data.

- Developed models for PGx on FHIR such as haplotypes, diplotypes and phenotypes
